# People Atlas 0.12.4 — Alpha

> [!WARNING]
> People Atlas 0.12.4 is an alpha version of the plugin. Its fundamental
> behavior is subject to change in future releases.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Compatibility: People Atlas 0.12.4 only supports Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer.
> Obsidian 1.12.x and older are not supported.**

People Atlas 0.12.4 simplifies the core experience around finding people,
understanding relationships, and following up.

> [!NOTE]
> Publishing People Atlas in the Community Plugins directory remains a separate
> step from this GitHub prerelease.

## Changes

- **Simpler navigation:** the primary views are now **Network**, **People**,
  and **Follow-up**.
- **Clearer network context:** technical labels were replaced with readable
  network-around and relationship-scope language.
- **Better people search:** the People view now exposes a native search field
  for finding and filtering people in the current view.
- **Quieter graph controls:** duplicate and rarely needed controls are reduced,
  while zoom remains available through progressive disclosure.
- **More meaningful relationships:** selecting a person reveals available
  relationship context without adding permanent labels to every graph edge.
- **Simpler person details:** contact entry is the primary action, with role,
  organization, relationships, latest contact, and follow-up information
  presented consistently across views.

## Breaking change / upgrade note

People Atlas 0.12.4 continues the fresh-vault-only boundary for the
presentation-first dossier layout. It does not migrate older folder layouts or
provide a backward-compatibility path for them.

## Assets

Install or update the plugin with the attached `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and
`styles.css`.
